bead.description:
AR-2026-05-17-repo finding. plan-2026-05-15-root-facade-extraction-inventory.md orders five extraction slices. Slice 1 (mixed facade splits) is in progress / accepted by the allowlist; slices 2-5 (serviceimpl, transcript/session, routehealth/quota/quality, root cleanup) have no per-slice beads yet. When slice 1 completes, file the slice-2 bead; chain slices 3-5 behind it. This bead is the reminder, not the work.

Source review: fizeau-90b85c8b.
bead.acceptance: When the worker picks this up: confirm slice 1 has landed (the allowlist test should still pass and the slice-1 files should be in their new packages), then file slices 2 through 5 as separate beads with deps slice-2 -> slice-3 -> slice-4 -> slice-5 and an ADR-008 spec-id on each. Close this reminder bead with notes pointing to the new bead IDs.
